ideas.pitch: A graph intelligence and risk detection platform built to trace agricultural supply chains, detect price manipulation, and flag fraudulent intermediary networks for Indian Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs).
ideas.title: KrishiGraph: AI-Powered Supply Chain AML & Price Risk Detection for Farmer Producer Organizations
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced graph intelligence and localized risk detection modeled after winning financial and compliance platforms like Bito, directly addressing the massive Indian agritech market focus of Build for Bharat.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient onboarding and clinical trust platform tailored for rural Indian healthcare providers, supporting vernacular voice inputs, automated intake triage, and regional medical compliance.
ideas.title: BhashaArogya: Multilingual AI Patient Acquisition and Trust Engine for Rural Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the winning formula of the Global-Smile patient acquisition engine for the unique vernacular and accessibility requirements of rural Indian healthcare markets.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite monitoring tool that detects unauthorized industrial land expansion, deforestation, and environmental regulatory violations across major Indian industrial zones using geospatial vector data.
ideas.title: SatEnviro-Compliance: Satellite-Powered Environmental Monitoring for Industrial Corridors in India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the hard engineering and high-impact industrial compliance monitoring demonstrated by GeoNex-ATLAS, targeting pressing environmental governance challenges in India.

ideas.pitch: A predictive modeling platform utilizing Poisson regression and multi-agent AI orchestration to forecast localized crop failures, pest outbreaks, and yield volatility for regional agricultural co-ops in India.
ideas.title: KrishiYield: Multi-Agent Micro-Weather and Crop Risk Forecasting Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous predictive statistical modeling and multi-agent student support architectures seen in top-tier forecasting and AI hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent platform that parses municipal and central government welfare schemes, maps them automatically to citizen eligibility profiles, and streamlines grievance tracking with verifiable status updates.
ideas.title: JanSahayak: Autonomous Multi-Agent Grievance Redressal and Scheme Matching Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets national governance and public service delivery—the core mandate of a flagship 'Build for Bharat' hackathon—using proven multi-agent RAG patterns.
